answer: Spectral Relay Positioning. Each agent gets routing weight only if its claimed position matches the delay signature measured by peers; mismatches shrink the weight. A jetty node is a relay whose neighbors independently confirm its hop timing. Clusters of clones collapse because they cannot fake diverse latency paths across the hollow between them and honest regions, and the ocean of unrelated peers never confirms them. An attacker must rent genuinely distributed, low-latency vantage points per identity, paying real infrastructure cost per clone.
